settings.headline: From Indian Soil to Your Cup
settings.subtext: Each origin tells a different story. Each cup reveals a different character. Explore our rotating single-origin selections.

settings.headline: From Cherry to Cup in 14 Days
settings.text: Most coffee on supermarket shelves was roasted 3-6 months ago. Our beans are harvested at peak ripeness, sun-dried on raised beds, and roasted in 10kg batches every Tuesday morning. By Wednesday, they're packed in nitrogen-flushed bags. By Friday, they're at your door. That's a 14-day journey from cherry to cup.

reviews.name: Vivek R.
reviews.text: I've been a specialty coffee snob for 5 years, importing beans from Ethiopia and Colombia. BrewCraft's Chikmagalur Arabica made me realize India produces world-class coffee. The fruity brightness on a V60 is spectacular. And it's a fraction of what I was paying for imports.

reviews.name: Kavitha S.
reviews.text: The subscription is genius. Fresh coffee delivered to my door every 2 weeks, 25% cheaper than buying individual bags. The Monsoon Malabar in my French press is my morning meditation. Rich, chocolatey, full-bodied — nothing instant coffee can touch.

reviews.name: James M.
reviews.text: The roast date on the bag was 3 days before delivery. THREE DAYS. I've never had coffee this fresh. My home espresso has never tasted this good — the crema is thick, the flavor is complex. This is what fresh coffee is supposed to taste like.

items.question: When is the coffee roasted?
items.answer: Every Tuesday morning. Orders placed by Monday midnight ship the same week with that Tuesday's fresh roast. Orders placed after Monday midnight ship with the following week's roast. Your bag will have the exact roast date printed on it.

items.question: What grind should I choose?
items.answer: We offer whole bean (recommended for maximum freshness), espresso fine, filter medium, French press coarse, and Moka pot fine. If you're unsure, our Brew Quiz recommends the perfect grind for your equipment.

items.question: What is SCA score?
items.answer: The Specialty Coffee Association (SCA) scores coffee on a 100-point scale. Anything above 80 is 'specialty grade.' Our beans consistently score 86-90, placing them in the top 5% of global coffee. We publish cupping notes and scores for every origin.

items.question: How does the subscription work?
items.answer: Choose your coffee, set your delivery frequency (every 1, 2, 3, or 4 weeks), and save 25%. We roast your beans fresh on the Tuesday before your scheduled delivery. Skip, pause, swap origins, or cancel anytime — no commitment.
